subject: Post-demo executive briefing + procurement path & risk summary
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Conrad <sarah.conrad@medisys.com>, Tom Erickson <terickson@medisys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo executive briefing + procurement path & risk summary

Sarah / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick executive-level recap from our call, plus the set of asks we agreed on so the procurement and security teams can evaluate next week. I put the most time-sensitive items at the top.

1) Topline business outcomes you emphasized
- Reduce per-call inference spend by ~35–45% vs current provider within 6 months (savings target for CFO).
- Improve triage/clinical-assistant latency to p95 <100ms for common prompts to keep clinician workflows uninterrupted.
- Ensure data residency for PHI-related inference in the us-east region and minimize data egress.

2) Primary pain points we heard (customer view)
- Frequent latency spikes during peak hours impacting adoption by on-shift clinicians.
- Lack of predictable unit economics; forecasting is manual and high variance.
- Procurement/security needs: SOC 2 evidence, DPA language, and a firm integration checklist for SSO/SCIM.

3) Key risks & mitigations (as discussed)
- Risk: SOC 2 documentation and audit artifacts timeline. Mitigation: we shared SOC2-attestation-stub.pdf in this thread; we'll pull in the compliance team and can provide the full package within 5 business days for review.
- Risk: Procurement wants a single-vendor SLA and a dedicated capacity option. Mitigation: outline Dedicated offering + draft SLA in SOW; price estimate attached.
- Risk: On-prem or VPC requirement for some PHI flows. Mitigation: private deployment option and hybrid routing patterns; we'll surface an architecture sketch in the follow-up workshop.

4) Procurement path & timeline (proposed)
- Day 0–3: Security questionnaire (we will complete items marked RFI in the attached doc).
- Day 3–7: Legal review of DPA and SOW; initial redlines to be exchanged via DocuSign/Conga.
- Week 2: Pilot PO or short-term reserved capacity commit (30–60 days) to prove latency and cost claims.
- Week 4–8: Rollout plan for additional models and production traffic if pilot succeeds.

5) Agreed next steps (owners & deadlines)
- Nikhil: Deliver pricing workbook and canary pilot SOW (attached) — today EOD (see pricing-estimate-20261129.xlsx).
- Dev: Schedule a 60-min integration workshop (SSO/SCIM + network requirements) with your cloud team — request: by end of day Mon 11/30.
- Laura: Coordinate compliance handoff and deliver SOC2 artifacts — within 2 business days.
- Tom/Sarah: Confirm internal approval owner (VP & CFO) and preferred procurement path (PO vs. direct SOW) — ideally by Tue 12/1.

6) Asks for your leadership team (explicit)
- Can you confirm who will own the vendor approval checklist from MediSys (name + email)?
- Please confirm whether MediSys needs an NDA or if the standard DPA is sufficient to move materials to legal.
- If CFO wants a 12–month vs 36–month price comparison, let us know and we'll produce both.

Attachments included: pricing-estimate-20261129.xlsx (pricing scenarios), redwood-inference-initial-mop.pdf (high-level plan), SOC2-attestation-stub.pdf (compliance stub).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call with your procurement lead if helpful.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma | Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
n: +1 415-555-0123 | nikhil.sharma@redwood.com

From: Sarah Conrad <sarah.conrad@medisys.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Tom Erickson <terickson@medisys.com>
Cc: MediSys Legal <legal@medisys.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo executive briefing + procurement path & risk summary

Nikhil — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side after today's exec readout: 

- VP Approval: I will own getting this to our VP of Clinical Ops (Dr. Elena Morris). She expects a 1‑page outcomes summary for her briefing; can you produce that by EOD Monday?
- CFO asks: show a best-case / worst-case TCO delta and the expected breakeven (we are sensitive to variability). Your pricing workbook is a good start — please include a 36-month amortized line too.
- Security: our security team flagged the need for an on-prem evaluation if cloud-only routing cannot guarantee PHI residency. They asked for a one-hour technical deep-dive with your architecture lead.

I've attached our internal security requirements (medisys-security-requirements-v1.docx). Legal will look at your DPA and SOW but asked to be looped on any DocuSign/Conga activity.

Tom — can you confirm whether procurement wants a PO (preferred) or will accept a short-term SOW and invoice model for the pilot?

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Conrad | VP, Clinical Systems | MediSys Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Conrad <sarah.conrad@medisys.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo executive briefing + procurement path & risk summary

Looping in action items on our side. Dev — please prioritize the integration workshop and the architecture sketch for hybrid routing (VPC + dedicated pool) for the security deep-dive. Target: 60–75 minute session; propose Tue 12/1 10:00–11:15 PT or Wed 12/2 08:00–09:15 PT and indicate required attendee list.

Nikhil — I'll draft the 1‑pager for Dr. Morris but need a crisp bullets version of outcomes (3 lines max) and the breakeven numbers (36m & 12m) by EOD today so we can finalize. If CFO will be shown slides, include the high-level cost deltas and risk mitigations.

I'll also pull Compliance to confirm the SOC 2 artifact set and timeline.

—Laura
Laura Bennett | Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Conrad <sarah.conrad@medisys.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo executive briefing + procurement path & risk summary

Acknowledged. I'll prepare the integration workshop agenda and the hybrid routing sketch. Proposed attendees: Dev Patel (Redwood Solutions Eng), SRE lead (Redwood), MediSys cloud infra lead, MediSys security architect.

I can do Tue 12/1 10:00 PT. I'll attach a short pre-read (network ports, expected traffic patterns, and latency test plan) ahead of the session.

—Dev
[Note: MediSys attached medisys-security-requirements-v1.docx; Redwood attached pricing-estimate-20261129.xlsx, redwood-inference-initial-mop.pdf, SOC2-attestation-stub.pdf]
